strings.dialog_pre_install_generic_tip:
• Zibira kimwe ekikwato kyawe kya MediaTek.

strings.dialog_pre_install_innioasis_tip:

• Reka akasimu ka USB kataine kakwate obwahati.
• Nyiga Continue, reero okorese ekikwato kyawe kurabira ahari USB waaba nooshabwa.

strings.donate_appeal_keep_going: Omugaruza busya ku eraabe yaakizire omuzaani waawe erizooba, teekateeka aha kuhayo, neeshashura za saava, neegyezaho eby’okukoresa, kandi neeta eby’okurya aha meeza yaitu .
strings.donate_coffee_pitch: Hi, Ryan hanu, waashanga ekikwato kyangye {app} nikihwera, noobaasa kungurira kaawa.
strings.donate_completion_body: Omugaruza busya n’eya busha, teine ​​burango kandi teine ​​n’okukuratira, neekora aha buconco bukye kuruga omu bantu nkaiwe. Ku kiraabe kyakukiza omurimo erizooba, okungurira kaawa nikituma okutunga ebiri aha Intaneeti kuguma nibikora.
strings.donate_completion_body_community: Ebitabo byaitu bya firmware hamwe n'ebikwato byaitu nibibiikwa aha Intaneeti ahabw'obushagiki bw'abantu. Buri kaawa neeha sente butoosha aha saava z’okutunga ebiri aha mukutu gw’ahaiguru kugira ngu mukama w’omuzaani orikukurataho nawe ashemererwe ebyeshongoro byabo.
strings.donate_completion_body_effort: Ebizaani ebirikutwarwa omu ngaro ebirikumurikira kandi ebirikuhindurwa nibitwara eshaaha nyingi z’okubireeberera ahabw’okwekundira. Updater CE ku eraabe yaakozire upgrade yaawe etaine nshonga erizooba, teekateeka aha kutugurira kaawa kubaasa kuguma n'entunguuka.
strings.donate_completion_body_family: App egi n'omurimo gw'omuntu omwe, kandi neegaaniira aha nju n'eka yangye. Ku kiraabe ngu okutaho erizooba kwanguhize ebintu kakye, omukaru n’omuringo gw’embabazi gw’okushagika eshaaha n’omutima ebiri enyima yaakyo.
strings.donate_completion_body_kindness: Tihariho kuhandiikisa kandi tihariho ekirikukingirwa. App ku eraabe ekaba eri ey’omugasho erizooba, okushashura kaawa omu maisho n’embabazi nkye ezirikugigumya ey’obuntu aha muntu orikukurataho.
strings.donate_completion_body_momentum: Nitwesiga obuhwezi bukye kubaasa kushashura esente z’okutaayaayira abagyenyi buri kwezi n’okuguma nitwebaasa. Okuteeka omu kaawa emwe yonka nikireetaho entaaniso mpango omu kuguma n’ekikwato eki kitari kya busha kandi kirikuguma nikibonezibwa.
strings.donate_completion_body_reciprocity: Updater CE n'eya busha, teine ​​burango kandi teine ​​n'okukuratira, neeheebwa sente zoona kuruga omu buconco bukye kuruga omu bantu nkaiwe. Okutaho oku kwaba kukurindiire obwire nari kwacungura ekikwato kyawe erizooba, okutugurira kaawa nikituma okutunga n’okukozesa za saava byaguma nibikora ahari buri omwe.
strings.donate_completion_body_running_costs: Servers, storage na domains nizishashurwa buri kwezi, yaaba omuntu weena yaataho eizooba eryo nari ngaaha. Ku kiraabe ngu okutaho erizooba kukaba kuri okurungi, omukaru gw’omukaru niguhwera omu kushashura esente ezo z’okugyenderamu ezitarimu kugamba.
strings.donate_completion_body_small_hours: Ebingi ahari purojekiti egi nibibaho omu shaaha nkye bwanyima y‘okukora omurimo gw‘eizooba, kandi kaawa n‘omuringo gw‘obucureezi gw‘okugira ngu kikaba kihikire. Mwebare kuba aha.
strings.donate_completion_body_transparency: 100% eigukire, etarimu nshonga, kandi erikwebemberwa abakozesa — tihaine paywalls nari ebikwato ebikingire. Omwani gw'ahonaaho aha Ko-fi nigutuhwera kushashura bandwidth n'okubiika ebyahaire amaani g'okutaho kwawe erizooba.

strings.donate_family_appeal_nursery: Ryan n'omukundwa we bariyo nibeeteekateekyera omwana waabo. Ekikwato eki kyaba kyabaire eky’omugasho, okuhayo sente z’okugikoresa n’eka yaitu erikweyongyera kukaba nikuza kuhwera okukira oku orikumanya.

strings.donate_intro_general: Halo! Ninye Ryan, omuhangu omu by’okutunguura Omugaruza busya, Ebibiikiro bya Firmware y’Ekicweka, n’Eby’okureeberaho by’Emitwe. Ninshashura okuriisa server, okubiika ebihandiiko bya firmware, n’okugaruza busya domain kuruga omu nsaho yangye kugira ngu buri kimwe kigume kiri busha. Okureeberera buri kwezi nikuhika ahari $200, obushagiki bwona obu orikuha nibuhwera kuguma n‘ebikwato ebi biriho ahabwa mukama waabyo orikukurataho.
strings.donate_intro_general_mediatek: Halo! Ninye Ryan, omuhangu omukukora ebiri enyima y'okutaho MediaTek. Ninshashura hosting, tooling n'okubiika ebintu kuruga omu nsaho yangye kubaasa kuguma nyine installer egi eya busha. Okugireeberera buri kwezi nikuhika ahari $200, obushagiki bwona obu orikuha nibuhwera okugigumaho ahabw’omukozesa orikukurataho.

strings.drop_firmware_here: Reka fairo ya puroguraamu aha kutaho
strings.drop_missing_images: Ebishushani ebimwe ebihandiikirwe omu fairo y’okujanjaaza tibirimu, n’ahabw’ekyo okutaho tikwatandikire.

strings.err_attempt_timeout: Ekikwato ekirikumurikira tikirikworeka okutunguuka omu {seconds} sekondi, n'ahabw'ekyo okugyezaho oku kukakyemerezibwa.
strings.err_auth_file_unusable_desc: Fayiro y'okuhamya ei waatoorana teriho, erimu busha nari terikubaasa kuhandiikwa. Toorana fairo ehikire, nari ogishemeze omu Settings, reero ogarukye ogikye.
strings.err_cache_file_missing_desc: Fayiro ya firmware erimu ebiri omu nshaho teriho. Toorana Select Software kugaruka kwombeka fairo eziihirwemu nari kugaruka kutunga ebihandiiko bya firmware. Eki n'ekizibu kya fairo y'omu kicweka, ti nshonga y'okutaho USB.
strings.err_code_missing_images: Ebishushani bya puroguraamu ya kompyuta bibuzire omu kibokisi
strings.err_code_partition_table_invalid: Okuhamya emeeza y'okugabanisamu kuremirwe bwanyima y'okuhandiika
strings.err_com_port_reboot_suggestion: Omumwanya gwa USB COM gukaba gutarikubaasa kwigurwa (enshobi 1013). Okugaruka kutandikaho kompyuta yaawe nikiija kurekura port ekingire. Nyabura we garukamu otandikye kompyuta yaawe kandi ogyezeho ogundi murundi.
strings.err_connect_failover_recovery:
{failed} tikirikubaasa kukwatiraine na {model} kyawe.

Omugaruzi hati naija kugyezaho {next} omumwanya gwayo.

Nyabura we, kwata USB kandi okozese ekikwato ky'okukwatiraho orupapura / pin kunyiga akapesha akari ahagati ya headphone jack na USB Port, reero onyige next.
strings.err_connection_failed_desc: Tibarikubaasa kutaho akakwate kahamire n’omuzaani. Reeba ngu ekikwato kyazima (kozesa pini kunyiga akapesha k’okugaruzaho kyaba nikyetengyesa), yihaho USB, kandi ogarukye okikwateho waaba nooshabwa.
strings.err_driver_missing_desc: Enshobi egi neebaasa kubaho omuvugi wa MediaTek USB yaaba ataine. Nyiga Download Drivers kubaasa kutaho omuvugi wa MediaTek USB, ogarukye otandikye kompyuta yaawe, kandi ogarukye ogyezeho.
strings.err_driver_missing_title: Omuvugi wa USB ya MediaTek Neyetengyesa
strings.err_flash_write_failed_desc: Okumurikira kukateganisibwa nari omurimo gw’okuhandiika gukaremwa. Reeba ngu akasimu ka USB kahamire kandi ngu battery eine charge erikumara, reero ogarukye ogyezeho.
strings.err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Enshobi etarikuteekateekwaho ekabaho omubwire bw'okutaho ({detail}). Zima amaani g’omuzaani goona, ogarukye okwateho waaba nooshabwa, kandi ogarukye ogyezeho.
strings.err_keep_data_failed: Tikirikubaasa kuguma n'ebintu byawe n'eby'amakuru: folda ya firmware terikuhandiikwa. Tihariho ekyateirweho.
strings.err_missing_package_files_desc: Ekicweka kya firmware nikibura fairo y’okujanjaaza nari fairo z’ebishushani ezirikwetengyesa. Nyabura we garuka otungye ekipapura nari otoore fairo ya firmware yoona.
strings.err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Ekikwato ekirikumurikira kyorekire omurongooti nigwo gumwe kumara sekondi {seconds} ezirikuhererukayo kandi tikirikureebeka ngu nikigumizamu kuhandiika puroguraamu ya firmware. Flash neebaasa kuba eremirwe. Eki kyaba kyabaire eky’aha muheru omu kugyezaho kabiri buri muringo aha nkora erikubaasa kugaruka enyima ahagati yaabo, nari shi MTKClient yonka yaaba eriho aha kyoma eki, garukamu otandikye kompyuta kandi ogyezeho ogundi murundi.
strings.err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Kompyuta egi neebaasa n’okutaho orikukoresa SP Flash Tool. Ku oraabe noobaasa, hindura okorese SP Flash Tool kandi ogarukye ogyezeho.
strings.err_only_mtkclient_desc: MTKClient yonka niyo eriho ahabw'okutaho eki. Flash neebaasa kuba eremirwe. Nyabura we garukamu otandikye kompyuta kandi ogyezeho ogundi murundi.
strings.err_pmt_format_required_desc: SP Flash Tool ekagira ngu emeeza y’okugabanisamu omuzaani ekahinduka (8502). Firimu egi eine kuteebwa omu muringo gwa Format All + Download, ogurikugaruka kuhindura ebiri omunda.
strings.err_restart_flash: Garuka otandikye flash kuruga aha kutandika
strings.err_sp_brom_da_fail: Omukozi w’okutunga ebiri aha Intaneeti tarabaasize kwoherezibwa omuzaani. Gizime kandi ogarukye ogikwate.
strings.err_sp_brom_startcmd: Omuzaani akatunga amaani kare munonga. Gizimye kimwe, reero ogarukye ogikwate.
strings.err_sp_com_port: Ekikwato ekyo kikaba kitarikubaasa kwiguraho serial port yaakyo. Kinga ebindi bikoreso ebirikumurikira kandi ogarukye obikwataniise.
strings.err_sp_da_init_sync: Omujwekyerwa w'okutunga tarabaasize kutandika. Gyezaho omuringo ogundi ogw’okuteera flash.
strings.err_sp_da_invalid_type: Ekikozeso ky'okutoora eky'oburinzi bw'ekyoma kyangire ekintu eki. Kozesa Download Agent eiziire na firmware egi, nari omulingo gwa SP Flash Tool ogurikwetengwa.
strings.err_sp_download_fail: Okuhandiika kukateganisibwa. Reeba USB cable na port hamwe na charge ya battery, reero ogyezeho ogarukye.
strings.err_sp_enable_dram: Ekikwato ekyo kikaba kitarikubaasa kutandikaho okwijuka kw’omuzaani. Koresa ekipapura ekyombekirwe ahabw’omuringo ogu gwenyini.
strings.err_sp_storage_read: Ekikwato ekyo kikaba kitarikubaasa kushoma ebi omuzaani arikubiika. Reeba oku birikukwatanisa; ekikwato nikibaasa kuba kiine obuzibu omu hardware.
strings.err_sp_timeout: Ekikwato tikikareebaga omuzaani. Guma oine amashanyarazi kandi otagiihireho, reero okorese akasimu ka USB waaba nooshabwa.
strings.err_sp_wrong_model: Omuzaani orikukwatanisa n‘eky‘okureeberaho ky‘omutaano kukira ebigyendererwa by‘ekipapura eki. Gikyebeho, reero oteho puroguraamu eyombekirwe omuzaani ogu.
strings.err_storage_full_desc: Kompyuta yaawe ehweireho omwanya gw'okubiikamu ebintu. Nyabura we, rugaho omwanya aha disiki yaawe ogarukye ogyezeho.
strings.err_tool_unavailable_desc: Ekikwato ekirikumurikira nari abavugi b’emotoka z’emigugu abarikwetengyesa tibarikubaasa kutandika. Nyabura reeba orusa rwa sisitemu, okutebekanisa kw'omuvugi, nainga ogarukye otemu puroguraamu.
strings.err_usb_bus_down_recovery: macOS terikubaasa kureeba ekikwato kyona ekya USB hati, n'ahabw'ekyo {model} yaawe terikubaasa kuhikirizibwa. Ihaho player hamwe na USB hub yoona nari dock, reero ogarukye otandikye Mac - USB controller neeyetenga amaani g'okutaho okundi kutakatandikire.
strings.err_usb_disconnected_recovery: {model} kyawe kikarugaho. Nyabura we, kwata USB kandi okozese ekikwato ky'okukwatiraho orupapura / pin kunyiga akapesha akari ahagati ya headphone jack na USB Port, reero onyige next.
strings.flash_cancel_msg: Enkora ya flash eriyo neekora obwahati. Nooyenda kugishazamu okatandikaho ensya?
strings.flash_close_confirm: Nohamya ngu noyenda kurekyera aho kutaho kandi okinge {app}?
strings.flash_connect_paperclip_prompt: Ekigyendererwa: Zima amashanyarazi g’ekikwato orikuteera aha rupapura orusherekirwe aha rubaju rw’ekikwato ky’okutaho amatu orikukoresa ekikwato ky’okukwatiraho nari pini.
strings.flash_connect_paperclip_prompt_a5: Ekihaburo: Zima amashanyarazi ga A5 yaawe orikuteera akapesha akasherekirwe aharubaju rw'akapesha k'amashanyarazi n'ekikwato orikukoresa ekikwato ky'okukwatiraho orupapura nari pini..

strings.flash_method_confirm: Omuringo gw'okutaho guhindukire {method}. Hamya ngu omuzaani yaaruga omu simu kandi yaazima, reero onyige Next.
strings.flash_method_note_auto: Okwekorera: Ekikwato kya SP Flash aha Windows na Linux, MTKClient aha macOS. You can switch manually on any platform.
strings.flash_method_note_mtk_mac: Omuringo gwa macOS ogurikugyeragyeranisibwa: nigukora Mac flow aha kyoma eki, MTKClient niyo yonka eri enyima kandi ebirikuhaburwa ebirikukwata ahari macOS nibyorekwa. Ahabw’okugyezibwa kwonka; app neegaruka etandika kukora.
strings.flash_method_note_sp: SP Flash Tool, MediaTek's official flasher. Aha Linux okwombeka kw’ekyanga nikuteebwa aha Intaneeti kandi kuteebwa aha nkora aha kubanza kukoresibwa.
strings.flash_paperclip_hint: Zima {model} yaawe yoona orikuteera aha rupapura orusherekirwe ahagati y'esimu n'emyanya ya USB orikukoresa ekikwato ky'okukwatiraho orupapura nari pini.
strings.flash_paperclip_hint_a5: Ekihaburo: Zima amashanyarazi g’ekikwato orikuteera aha rupapura orusherekirwe haihi n’eibaare ry’amashanyarazi orikukoresa ekikwato ky’okukwatiraho empapura nari pini.
strings.flash_preparing: Okutebekanisa ekipapura kya firmware... Guma ekikwato kitariho obwahati.
strings.flash_searching: Okuronda ekikwato kyawe... Hati zibira ekikwato kandi okorese akasimu ka USB.
strings.flash_sp_gui_tooltip: Iguraho ekikwato kya MediaTek SP GUI
strings.flash_wait_desc: Banza ozime amaani g’ekikwato. Ku kiraabe kikwataniise kwonka kitamanyirwe, gyezaho akasimu ka USB nari port endiijo.
strings.flash_warning: Otaihaho amashanyarazi, akasimu ka USB, nari kukinga ekikwato.
strings.flash_watch_found: Omuzaani ashangwa, okwongyera aha mitwe ya Rockbox...
strings.flash_watch_timeout_hint: Reeba ngu erimu amashanyarazi kandi erimu n’omuriro. Ku kiraabe kyaguma kiri omu mwirima, nyiga pini omu kiina ky’okugaruzaho kandi okwate aha rupapura rwa rwagati (Y1) nari aha rupapura rw’amaani (abazaani abandi) kugaruka kugitandika. strings.flash_y1_preloader_hint: Ekigyendererwa: Zima amashanyarazi orikuteera aha rupapura orusherekirwe aha rubaju rw’ekikwato ky’okutaho amatu n’ekikwato ky’okukwatiraho nari pini. Kwatanisa USB omu muringo gwa buriijo otaine kukwaata amapesha.

strings.retry_guidance_intro: USB erikukwatanisa na player yaawe erekyeire aho kugarukamu. Omuzaani waawe nayetenga kugaruka omu nkora (manual reset) okugyezaho okundi kutakakozire.
strings.retry_guidance_step_1: 1. Ihaho akasimu ka USB kuruga omu player yaawe.
strings.retry_guidance_step_2: 2. Nyiga akapesha k’okugaruzaho akasherekirwe n’ekikwato ky’okukwatiraho empapura nari ekikwato ky’okutu.
strings.retry_guidance_step_3: 3. Garuka otemu akasimu ka USB, reero ogyezeho ogundi murundi.
strings.return to Device Model and confirm the p: garuka aha Device Model kandi ohamye eky’okureeberaho ekihandiikirwe. Aha Y1, hamya Type A nari Type B otakagarukiremu kutoorana ekintu.
strings.rockbox_manual_guide:
1. Toorana ‘USB Storage Mode’ aha muzaano gwawe.
2. Nyiga 'Browse Folder...' kutoorana omuzaani waawe kandi oteho emitwe.

strings.rockbox_stage_pushing: Omuzaani yashangwa. Okutaho emitwe y'ekyanga hamwe n'ebigambo...

strings.rockbox_step_usb_storage_mode: Nyabura we, taho omuringo gw'okubiika USB aha kikwato kyawe kandi onyige Ekindi
strings.rockbox_troubleshoot_desc: {model} yaawe yaaba etarikutandika, kwata USB, okwate aha rupapura rw'amaani kumara 10s kugaruka kutaho, kandi oteho amaani. Nari kugaruraho puroguraamu y’okubanza.
strings.rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: App egi nereeba ngu ADB ekwatanisa (okuhitsya sekondi 30). Ekikwato kyashangwa, emitwe neehindurwa kandi omuzaani naagaruka atandika. Ekindi, ruga omu maisho oze omu muringo gw’okubiika USB.
strings.rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: Okuhingisa kwa ADB kuremirwe; okugaruka omu muringo gw'okubiika USB
strings.rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Tihariho kikwato kya ADB ekyashangirwe omu bwire bwa sekondi 30; okugumizamu n’omuringo gw’okubiika USB.
strings.rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Hati noobaasa kusharaho omuzaani otaine kabi koona kandi otoore omutwe omu Rockbox (Eby’okutebeekanisa > Ebitebeekanisiibwe by’Omutwe).
strings.rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Tihariho ADB binary eriho aha app; okugumizamu n’omuringo gw’okubiika USB.
strings.rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Taho akasimu ka USB.
2. Garuka oteho amaani g'omuzaani kandi omurekye atandike kuza omu Rockbox.
3. Rockbox ku eraabe neekora, ogarukye okorese akasimu ka USB, reero onyige Continue.
strings.rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_power: Kwata akapesha k’amaani kubaasa kutaho amaani omu player yaawe, ogarukye okore USB, reero otoore USB Storage Mode.
strings.rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_y1: Kwata akapesha ka rwagati kubaasa kutaho Y1 yaawe, ogarukye okore USB, reero otoore USB Storage Mode.
strings.rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Eidaara 1: Garuka otandikireho omuzaani kandi ogarukye okore

1. Taho USB Storage Mode aha player kugira ngu ereebekye nk'omuvugi.
2. Toorana folda yoona aha player eri ahaifo (.rockbox, Ebyeshongoro, Emitwe, nari omuzi gwa drive, folda ya .rockbox esherekirwe neeshangwa yonka).
3. App neekwatanisa emitwe ya 360p n’ebigambo omu, ehandiika aha fairo z’eiziina rimwe.

strings.sel_multiple_scatters_error: Ebipapura bya firmware bingi nari fairo z’okujanjaara bikashangwa omu folda/ekibiikiro eki. Nyabura we toorana folda nari eibiikiro eririmu puroguraamu emwe yonka omurundi gumwe.
strings.sel_multiple_scatters_release_error: Ekihandiiko eki kirimu fairo z’okujanjaaza ezirikurenga ahari emwe, n’ahabw’ekyo Updater terikubaasa kumanya layout ei omuzaani waawe arikwetenga. Omukozi wa {software} naija kwetenga kuhindura ebihandiiko byabo bya firmware kubaasa kutamu fairo emwe yonka ey'okujanjaaza.
strings.sel_offline: Ebihandiiko ebiri aha Intaneeti tibiriho hati. Koresa fairo y’omu kicweka kyawe, nari reeba oku orikukwatanisa.
strings.sel_offline_install: Teekaho puroguraamu kuruga omu fairo ya .zip nari .rar aha kikwato kyona eky’okuhurikiza Innioasis nari Timmkoo.
strings.sel_offline_install_generic: Teekaho puroguraamu kuruga omu .zip/.rar archive nari omu folda ya puroguraamu aha bikwato bya MediaTek eby’omutaano.
strings.sel_only_local: Toorana .zip nari .rar firmware y’omu kicweka kyawe ey’okutaho aha Intaneeti, tihariho intaneeti erikwetengyesa. Nikikora na buri kimwe ekirikuteera amakuru ekya Innioasis na Timmkoo.
strings.sel_only_local_generic: Toorana ekicweka kya firmware eky’omu kicweka (.zip, .rar) nari folda erimu fairo y’okujanjaaza ey’okutaho aha Intaneeti, neekora n’ebyoma bya MediaTek eby’omutaano.
strings.sel_prompt_need_firmware: Nyabura we toorana .zip, .rar archive, nari fairo y'okujanjaaza (*scatter*.txt) omunda ya folda ya puroguraamu y'okukoresa kubaasa kutaho puroguraamu y'okukoresa ei waatoorana aha {target} kyawe.
strings.sel_source_desc: Taho puroguramu aha intaneeti, nainga oreete ekipapura ky'omukicweka.
strings.sel_themepack_guidance_body:
Nyabura we, kwatanisa USB, oteho amashanyarazi kandi otandikye omu Rockbox omurundi gumwe (n'ahabw'ekyo neetandika folda yaayo ey'omunda ya .rockbox system), reero ogarukye okore USB kandi otoore 'USB Storage Mode'.

Ku orikuba oine akakwate, nyiga Continue kutoorana folda yoona eri aha player yaawe.
strings.sel_themepack_guidance_title: Kwatanisa omuzaani omu muringo gw'okubiika USB
strings.sel_themepack_prompt_body: Oine flash y'okwombeka Rockbox eya 360p. Noyenda kutaho 360p Theme Pack aha kikwato eki hati?
strings.sel_themepack_prompt_title: Oine kutaho ekipapura ky’omutwe gwa Rockbox 360p?
strings.sel_themepack_select_folder: Toorana folda yoona aha kibiiko ky'omuzaani waawe orikukwatanisa
strings.sel_themepack_success: Rockbox Theme Pack etungire gye aha kikwato kyawe!
strings.sel_type_help_body:
Gyezaho Sofutiweya y’omuringo gwa A okubanza.

Omuzingo gwawe gwaba gutarikugarukamu bwanyima y’okugutaho, taho kimwe aha miringo ya Type B.

Ebikwato bya Type B n’ebyo ebyabaire nibiija n’ebicweka bya firmware ebyabaireho enyima ya 2.0.
strings.sel_type_help_tooltip: Gyezaho Sofutiweya y’omuringo gwa A okubanza. Enziga yaawe yaaba etarikugarukamu bwanyima y’okugitaho, taho kimwe aha miringo ya Type B.
strings.settings_240p_tip: Okworeka ebyombeko ebi ROM yaabo eri omu muringo gwa 240p (rom..._240p.zip). 240p ebyombeko tibirikuhikaana n’ebicweka bya Y1 aha Innioasis OS ahansi ya 3.0.7, n’ahabw’ekyo Yoreka ebyombeko bya Rockbox ebya ira nibishoboororwa nabyo.
strings.settings_add_device_no_versions: Tihariho bihandiiko ebiriho ebya puroguraamu egi hati.
strings.settings_advanced_desc: Yoreka aha rurengo rwahansi rwa flash backends hamwe n'emiringo y'okutaho terminal.
strings.settings_allow_keep_data_any: Buriijo yehayo kuguma n'ebintu byangye n'eby'amakuru
strings.settings_allow_keep_data_any_desc: Okwihaho ekibuuzo ky’okuhikaana. Kozesa eki kyonka waaba noohamya ngu omuzaani naija kuguma naakora n’ebintu ebi arikukora hati n’eby’amakuru.
strings.settings_arm64_driver_note: ARM64 Obushagiki bwa Windows tiburikugyezibwa. Aha laptop za Snapdragon na RTX Spark, Zadig neebaasa kukoresibwa n’okutaho omukono gw’omuvugi guremirwe kutaho WinUSB nari libusb ahabw’ekikwato kya MT6227 Preloader omu Mutegyeki w’Ekikwato. Reeba obuhabuzi bw‘omuvugi wa ARM64 ahabw‘amatembezo.
strings.settings_cache_desc: Ihaho ebipapura bya firmware ebiteirwe aha Intaneeti hamwe na fairo za ROM eziteirweho kubaasa kucungura omwanya aha disiki. Ebyafaayo byawe by'okutaho hamwe n'okugaruza busya eby'okwijutsya ebi orikwenda birabiikwa.
strings.settings_cache_group: Obiiko bwa puroguraamu ya kompyuta & Cache
strings.settings_checker_desc: Nikitebeekanisa ingini erikumurika, bwanyima kikyebera oku USB erikubaasa kutunga, guruupu z’abarikugikozesa n’ebicweka bya kernel serial.
strings.settings_checker_desc_advanced: Nikikyebera okutebeekanisa kwa Linux okw’omurembe ahabwa SP Flash Tool, okutunga USB, orusa rwa serial, n’ebicweka bya system.
strings.settings_checker_desc_friendly: Nikitebeekanisa kompyuta yaawe kubaasa kukwatiraine n’omuzaani waawe n’okutaho puroguraamu ezisya omu muringo ogurikwesigwa.
strings.settings_checker_desc_installer: Nikitebeekanisa kompyuta yaawe kubaasa kukwatiraine n’omuzaani waawe kutunga puroguraamu ezirikugarurwaho.
strings.settings_driver_desc: Otakakozeise app egi omurundi gw’okubanza, oine kutaho omuvugi wa MediaTek USB, reero ogarukye otandikireho kompyuta yaawe.
strings.settings_filter_nightly: Yoreka ebyashohozibwa bya Dev buri kiro
strings.settings_filter_original_pre307: Yoreka Sofutiweya y'onyini eya ira erikurenga 3.0.7.
strings.settings_firmware_up_to_date: Ebikwato byona ebirikukuratirirwa biriyo nibikora puroguraamu ensya!
strings.settings_guided_install: Nyebembere kurabira omu kutaho omu app
strings.settings_guided_install_desc: App neeguma naiwe orikugizibira, okugikwatanisa, n’okugitaho.
strings.settings_hide_donations_tip: Nikishereka ebihandiiko by’okuhayo n’amapesha. Nobaasa kuguma noogura kaawa kuruga omu Settings waaba nooyenda.
strings.settings_install_themes_desc: Ku kirikubaasika, emitwe ya Rockbox neehindurwa omu Y1 bwanyima y’okutaho Rockbox omu muringo oguhikire.
strings.settings_no_devices_tracked: Tihariho eby’okukoresa ebiteirweho ebihandiikirwe. Flash ekikwato kubaasa kushoboorora version.
strings.settings_not_installed: Tihariho kuteekaho okuhandiikirwe hati (okubiikwa bwanyima y'okumurikira)
strings.settings_notifications_desc: Yoreka ebimanyiso bya system ahabw'ekimanyiso n'emiringo y'okugaruzaho ahaifo. Off neeguma neebiika buri kimwe omunda ya app.
strings.settings_notifications_unavailable: Ebimanyiso bya system tibiriho aha kompyuta egi.
strings.settings_offline_mode_desc: Shereka akatabo k’abantu b’omu kyanga aha Intaneeti kandi oteho puroguraamu kuruga omu fairo z’omu kicweka zonka.
strings.settings_old_rockbox_warn_body:
Ebihandiiko bya Rockbox-Y1 ebitakahikire 0.5 tibirikuhikaana n’ebicweka bya Y1 ebyaguziibwe bwanyima ya Maaci 2026 na Innioasis OS 3.0.7 ebaire eteirweho.

Okutaho build eya ira aha bikwato ebi nikiija kuzibira okutandika.

Nohamya ngu noyenda kworeka ebyombeko bya Rockbox ebya ira?
strings.settings_original_pre307_warn_body:
Sofutiweya y’okubanza eya ira erikurenga 3.0.7 terikuhikaana na Y1 ezirikuguzibwa na Innioasis OS 3.0.7. Okutaho build eya ira aha units ezi nikiija kuziremesa kutandika kuhitsya obu version ensya eragarukyeho.

Noohamya ngu nooyenda kworeka ebihandiiko bya Original Software ebya ira ebirikukira ahari 3.0.7?
strings.settings_reminders_desc: Omugaruza busya naijuka firmware version eyateirwe aha bazaani baawe ba Innioasis, neekumanyisa ebisya byaheza kubaho.
strings.settings_reminders_tracked: Noija kumanyisibwa okushohoza okusya kwaba nikureebeka ahari puroguraamu ei otaire aha {software}. Ekuratiirwe hati: {devices}
strings.settings_reminders_tracked_multi: Nitwija kubamanyisa obu ebicweka bisya bya ebi biraashohore.
strings.settings_reminders_tracked_named: Nitwija kukumanyisa obu omuringo musya gwa {software} gurashohore ahabwa {model} yaawe.
strings.settings_reminders_tracked_original: Nitwija kukumanyisa obu puroguraamu ensya eya {model} yaawe eraashohore.
strings.settings_rockbox_desc: Nikikoresibwa waaba noocondooza aha bihandiiko bya puroguraamu.
strings.settings_run_as_admin_desc: Shaba Windows obugabe bw’okutegyeka waatandika kutaho. SP Flash Tool na MTKClient bwanyima nizikora n’okutunga okuhikire, omuhanda gw’okushoboorora oburemeezi omuvugi nari omwaaro gwayanga kwigura.
strings.settings_run_as_admin_restart_needed: Omugaruza busya eine kugaruka kutandika kugira ngu installs zikore n'obugabe obu.
strings.settings_run_as_superuser_desc: Run installs n'obugabe bw'omuzi kurabira omu pkexec. Kikorese enshobi y’orusa yaaba neezibira ekikwato kya flash.
strings.settings_run_in_background_desc: Guma app omu menyu bar nari omu system tray bwanyima y’okukinga edirisa, kugira ngu okyeyongyere kutunga amakuru g’okugaruzaho app na player firmware. Off: okukinga edirisa nikiruga omu app.
strings.settings_run_in_background_desc_menu_bar: Guma app omu menyu bar bwanyima y’edirisa kukinga, kugira ngu oguma nootunga okumanyisibwa okurikukwata aha kuhindura app na player firmware. Off: okukinga edirisa nikiruga omu app.
strings.settings_run_in_background_desc_system_t: Reka app omu system tray bwanyima y’okukinga edirisa, kugira ngu okyemereze okutunga okumanyisibwa okurikukwata aha kuhindura app na player firmware. Off: okukinga edirisa nikiruga omu app.
strings.settings_skip_install_donations_tip: Yoreka ebicweka by’okuheza ebyanguhi otashabire sente bwanyima y’okujwara.
strings.settings_sp_auth_desc: Tikya boona. Ebigyendererwa bya MediaTek ebimwe nibyanga kujwara okuhitsya obu SP Flash Tool eraheebwa fairo y’okuhamya (.auth); yongyeraho eyaawe aha ekikwato kyaba nikyetenga.
strings.settings_sp_gui_desc: Nikikingaho Omugaruza busya kandi nikiiguraho SP Flash Tool GUI erimu fairo y’okujanjaaza eya firmware etoorainwe n’ebishushani by’okugabanisa ebiteirweho kare.
strings.settings_sp_gui_install: Teekaho omu SP Flash Ekikwato GUI
strings.settings_terminal_desc: Nikikora okutaho puroguraamu yaawe omu Terminal kugira ngu obone kureeba amakuru g’eby’obuhangwa aha ntunguuka.
strings.settings_terminal_desc_windows: Nikikora okutaho puroguraamu yaawe omu Command Prompt kugira ngu obone kureeba amakuru g’eby’obuhangwa aha ntunguuka.
strings.settings_themes_refresh_failed: Tibarikubaasa kugaruramu amaani; emitwe ebibiikire n’obunaku obu eriho.
strings.simulated_mac_body: MTKClient neehinduka omuringo gwonka gw’okutaho kandi ebihandiiko ebirikukwata ahari macOS nibyorekwa. Omugaruza busya neyetenga kugaruka kutandika kubaasa kuta eki omu nkora.
strings.simulated_mac_body_mediatek: MTKClient neehinduka omuringo gwonka gw’okutaho kandi ebihandiiko ebirikukwata ahari macOS nibyorekwa. MediaTek Installer neyetenga kugaruka kutandika kubaasa kuta eki omu nkora.
strings.simulated_mac_title: Hindukira omu muringo gwa macOS ogurikugyeragyeranisibwa
strings.single_instance_body: Kopi endiijo eigukire, nari ekiriho neekora omu rubaju rw’enyima. Kopi ibiri zikaba niziza kuhakanisa ahabw’okutaho USB y’omuzaani, n’ahabw’ekyo egi terikwija kutandika.
strings.single_instance_busy_body: Kopi erikwiruka n’okutaho puroguraamu nari okugamba n’omuzaani, n’ahabw’ekyo okugihendera hati nikiija kuteganisa ekyo. Okutongoza oku nikwija kukinga; kozesa edirisa eriho nari akabonero kaayo aka menu bar waaheza kutaho.
strings.single_instance_focus_failed: Kopi erikwiruka tegarukiremu okushaba kworeka edirisa yaayo. Noobaasa kugyemesereza kukireka kandi otandikye eki omu mwanya gwakyo.
strings.single_instance_force_failed: Kopi erikwiruka ekaba etarikubaasa kuhendera. Rekaho iwe wenka, reero ogarukye otandikye okugihindura.

strings.sp_config_missing_platform: Fayiro y’okujanjaaza terikurangirira omukura gwayo, n’ahabw’ekyo okutebeekanisa kwa konsole ahabwa fairo y’okuhamya tikubaasa kwombekwa; okumurikira hatariho n’ekyo.
strings.sp_config_missing_storage: Fayiro y’okujanjaaza terikurangirira ekika ky’okubiika (EMMC/NAND/UFS), n’ahabw’ekyo okutebeekanisa kwa konsole ahabwa fairo y’okuhamya tikubaasa kwombekwa; okumurikira hatariho n’ekyo.
strings.sp_config_no_auth_file: Tihariho fairo y’okuhamya eyaaheebwa; okumurikira hatariho n’emwe.
strings.sp_config_write_failed: Tibarikubaasa kuhandiika fairo y’okutebeekanisa konsole; okujwara hatariho fairo y’okuhamya.

strings.sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Tool GUI hati neija kwiguraho puroguraamu yaawe erimu puroguraamu.

• Omu SP Flash Tool, toorana "Format Byona + Otungye" kuruga omu kabokisi akarikuza ahansi.
• Nyiga aha rupapura oruriho "Download".
• Reeba ngu {device} kyazimirwa kandi kyarugaho.
{hint}
• Kwatanisa akasimu ka USB ahari kompyuta yaawe bwanyima y’okuteera aha Download.

Nyiga OK kutandikaho Ekikwato kya SP Flash kandi oze omu Omugaruza busya.
strings.sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Taho kurabira omu SP Flash Ekikwato GUI
strings.sp_gui_launch_intro:
SP Flash Tool GUI will now launch.

• Ku kiraabe kitakazimiire, zibira ekikwato kyawe.
• Ku eraabe ekwataniise na USB, banza ogihaho.
• Omu SP Flash Tool, nyiga aha Kutaho (nari Format Byona + Kutaho nk’oku kirikwetengyesa).

Then connect the USB cable to begin flashing.
strings.sp_gui_launched_status: Ekikwato kya SP Flash GUI kyatongozibwa
strings.sp_gui_no_cached_firmware: Tihariho ekicweka kya firmware ekibiikire kuruga omu kugyezaho kutaho okwabandize ekyashangirwe, nari ebishushani by'okugabanisa ebirikwetengyesa bibuzire. Nyabura we banza otoorane nari otungye puroguraamu erikurugayo otakaigure SP Flash Tool.
strings.sp_gui_not_supported: GUI y’ekikwato kya SP Flash neeshangwa aha Windows yonka kandi neeshagikwa Linux (x86/x86_64).
strings.sp_gui_preparing_firmware: Ekicweka kya firmware tikihikire, okukitunga n’okukiihayo otakakingire SP Flash Tool.

strings.status_app_reset_defaults: App egarukiremu kimwe nk'oku kyabaire kiri, ekibiikiro ky'okutunga kyashazibwamu, kandi n'ekiijutsyo kya battery kyagarurwamu.
strings.status_terminal_install: Taho ekiragiro ekikingirwe omu dirisa yaawe ({path}).
strings.support_methods_subtitle: Toorana omuringo ogu orikwenda kuhayo. Buri kiconco nikiha sente z’okutunga, okuriisa, n’okugyezaho eby’okukoresa.
strings.support_story_1_body: Innioasis buriijo neeshohoza firmwares ensya z’abazaani nka Y1 (ezirikuta omutima aha kuhindura aha board ezisherekirwe nka 6.0, 7.0, na 8.0) ezirikuhenda eby’okukoresa ebya ira omu bucureezi. Ekibi munonga, omukutu gwabo niguha okurabura kwa zero n’okutunga zero aha puroguraamu ezaabaire nizikora enyima kugaruka omu mbeera y’amatafaari. Omugaruza busya na purojekiti ya Community Firmware nibitwara ebicweka: nitubiika buri ROM y’eira, nituhamya okuhindura kwa hardware yaawe, kandi nituguma nituteera gye omuzaani waawe.
strings.support_story_1_headline: Abakozi ku barikuza omu maisho, abantu b’omu kyanga nibatunguuka.
strings.support_story_1_item_1: Okucungura Abazaani Abacwekire: Okukyebera eby’okwerinda nikuhamya ngu ebisya tibirikuhenda eby’okukoresa ebya ira.
strings.support_story_1_item_2: ROMs ezibiikire: Okuteerana kw’ebintu byona ebyabaire biri omu ikorero Innioasis bikasazibwamu.
strings.support_story_1_item_3: Ebikwato by’okukoresa omu nkora: Ebikwato by’okukoresa omu macOS, Linux, na Windows nk’oku biri.
strings.support_story_1_item_4: Hardware Intelligence: Okumanyisa board omu muringo gw’okwemanyiza kugira ngu buriijo otungye ekipapura ekihikire.
strings.support_story_1_lead: Okurinda ekikwato kyawe obutakwatwa emitego ya hardware etarikugamba n’okugarukamu okucwekire.
strings.support_story_2_body: Okukuratira puroguraamu ya Innioasis etongore nikikira kumanyisa okucondooza aha mikutu y’empurizana ahabw’enkoragana za Google Drive ezihweireho, okugaaniira kwa Baidu omu bicu okufiire, na fairo za zip ezitarikumanywa ezitaine bikwato ebirikujwara. Twombekire omukutu ogurikwesigwa, ogw’okwetongora ogw’okutunga ebiri aha Intaneeti n’oburingaaniza bwa SHA-256 obuhamibwe, okumanyisibwa okurikugarurwa busya, n’okutaho ebirikwebemberwa eitembezo aha itembezo. Ebi orikuhayo nibiguma nibibiika butoosha ebi orikutunga n’okubitunga ebirikubaasisa eki kubaho eshaaha 24 buri izooba, ebiro 365 omu mwaka.
strings.support_story_2_headline: Tihariho Google Drive ezicwekire. Tihariho kuteebereza-okukora. Firmware erikukora yonka.
strings.support_story_2_item_1: Direct High-Speed ​​CDN: Okutunga ebiri aha Intaneeti omu bwire bukye kandi hatariho bugarukiro bw’okubitunga nari ebirikukwata aha Intaneeti ebifiire.
strings.support_story_2_item_2: Ebimanyiso by‘okugaruzaho: Yemanyisibwa omu bwire obu ebisya by‘ekyanga birikushohoza nari ebitebeekanisiibwe birikugwa.
strings.support_story_2_item_3: Okutaho Okuhaburwa Eitembezo aha Idaara: Ebirikureebwa gye nibikutwara omu buri kuteera akapesha.
strings.support_story_2_item_4: Ekibiina ky’endimi nyingi: Ekirikugambwa omu bwijwire omu Rungyereza, Oruchaina, Orugirimaani, Orusipeyini, Orufaransa & Orujapani.
strings.support_story_2_lead: Eby‘obugaiga by‘ekyanga eby‘omuvuyo gw‘ahaiguru, ebihamibwe ebi orikubaasa kwesiga buzima.
strings.support_story_3_body: Sofutiweya ya Stock factory neesharaho aha mutwe gw’ebi hardware yaawe eya Y1 nari Y2 erikubaasa kukora. Ekicweka kyaitu kikareetera Rockbox, enkora z’okukoresa ezitari z’amaani, okuteera kwa audiophile codec, n’emitwe y’omutaano omu magara. Nitugura empindahinduka z’ebintu by’omubiri kuruga omu nsaho kugyezaho, kugarura enyima, n’okuhamya buri kutaho. Okushagika Omugaruza busya nikuha sente z’okugyezesa ebi kandi nikutunguura puroguraamu z’okukoresa omu muringo gw’omutaano.
strings.support_story_3_headline: Okwiguraho obushoboorozi bwona obw'omuzaani waawe wa Innioasis.
strings.support_story_3_item_1: One-Click Rockbox: Okuteera amakuru n’emitwe y’abantu erikuteebwaho omu bwire bukye.
strings.support_story_3_item_2: Firmware y'ekyanga: Okutunguura battery, UI eshemeire, hamwe n'obushagiki bwa codec y'amakuru ey'omurembe.
strings.support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Nitugyezaho aha bikwato by’omubiri eby’amazima tutakashohoize ekyombeko kyona.
strings.support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% ya busha, puroguraamu y’okubanza ey’ekihama etaine burango nari okukuratira.
strings.support_story_3_lead: Okureeta Rockbox, enkora z’okukora ezitari z’amaani, n’obugabe bw’okuhurikiza.
strings.support_story_4_body: Kampuni y’ebyoma bya hardware ku erikuza aha kikwato kyabo ekindi, eby’okukoresa ebya ira nibirekyerwaho. Innioasis terikuhereza obushagiki bwa Linux, tihariho changes ezirikureebwa, kandi tihariho muringo gworobi gw’okugarukaho waaba otaireho kuremwa. Omugaruza busya eriho ahabwokuba abakozesa abaine ekihika tibashemerire kunaga ekikwato ky’okuteera ebyeshongoro ekirungi munonga. 100% y‘ebintu ebirikuheebwayo eby‘ekyanga nibiza butunu omu kuguma n‘ekikwato eki kikingire buri omwe.
strings.support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: Okugaruka omu buteeka okuhamibwe nikugyendera n’obu eby’okukoresa byayanga kutandika.
strings.support_story_4_item_2: Obushagiki bwa Linux obw’omutindo gw’okubanza: Obushagiki bwona MediaTek erikumurikira aha distros za Linux.
strings.support_story_4_item_3: Transparent Changelogs: Ebihandiiko ebirikushohozibwa omu bwijwire kugira ngu omanye gye empindahinduka.

strings.themepack_card_desc: Harimu emitwe mirungi y’ekyanga, ebishushani by’enyima ebirimu ebiriisa bingi, n’ebigambo ebikozirwe ahabw’okworeka 360p.
strings.themepack_complete: Theme pack ekateebwaho gye! Hati noobaasa kusharaho omuzaani waawe otaine kabi koona kandi otoore omutwe omu Rockbox (Ebitebeekanisiibwe > Ebitebeekanisiibwe Omutwe).
strings.themepack_err_not_found: Tikirikubaasa kutunga nari kutandikaho endagiriro ya .rockbox aha diiraiva etoorainwe. Nyabura we reeba ngu waatoorana folda aha player yaawe.
strings.themepack_step1_desc:
1. Taho omuzaani waawe orikukwata aha rupapura rwa Power.
2. Rockbox ku eratandikire, ta akasimu ka USB omu kompyuta yaawe.
3. Ku kiraabe nikishabwa aha skriini y’omuzaani, hamya USB Storage mode kugira ngu ekikwato kireebekye nk’omuvugi.
strings.themepack_step1_title: Eidaara 1: Kwatanisa omu muringo gw'okubiika USB
strings.themepack_step2_desc: Ahabw’okugira ngu enkora z’okukoresa (nka macOS) nizishereka dotfiles (nka .rockbox) nk’oku ziri, noobaasa kutoorana folda YONA nari omuzi gwa drive aha player yaawe. Nitwija kukusherura nari kukukorera endagiriro ya .rockbox.
strings.themepack_step2_title: Eidaara 2: Toorana Folder yoona eri aha Player .
